# authwise_guard_pool_relays (Data Source)

A relay of an estate relay pool. Operators only. Changing `pool` moves the relay; it learns the move on its next report. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `guard_pool_relays` (Attributes List) Every pool_relay under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guard_pool_relays))

Read-Only:

- `config` (String)

- `has_credential` (Boolean)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `last_report_at` (String)

- `url` (String)
